##### Project general facts

Starlight Park is a luxury residential project by Amwaj Development, comprising a cluster of low-rise buildings with rooftops and a collection of one- to three-bedroom apartments. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the development embodies family-centric living, with a thoughtfully designed community area at the heart of the compound.

Starlight Park features an impressive array of resort-style facilities, including a rooftop pool with panoramic views, a fitness studio, a rooftop cinema, a yoga studio, a boxing studio, a paddle tennis court, indoor and outdoor kids' play areas, a residents' lounge and a lobby lounge. EV charging stations and round-the-clock security complete a dynamic living experience in which every element is designed to elevate everyday life.

Residences blend elegance and functionality with contemporary design and designer touches. Apartments are delivered semi-furnished, with premium kitchen appliances, a built-in TV unit and a bespoke wall accent in the master bedroom, while kitchen and dining areas combine practicality with style and modern bathrooms offer a sense of calm. Select units feature private pools, creating a personal retreat for relaxation.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan is a sustainable and forward-looking city along Al Ain Road that positions Dubai on the global business stage and offers residents an exceptional quality of life.

The district is distinguished by its connectivity to key destinations, with Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, Dubai International Airport, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, Burj Al Arab, Mall of the Emirates and Al Maktoum International Airport all within easy reach. This strategic position gives residents seamless access to the city's most iconic landmarks and vibrant districts.

Meydan combines world-class amenities, strategic connectivity and a prestigious address, making it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations for families and investors alike. The area's master-planned environment supports strong demand for quality residential living.
